rationale: Adopt AELYS's audited recommendation: improve reliability, memory use and specialization before increasing agent count.

phases.name: BASELINE
phases.result: 5 real workers and 5 distinct outputs, but semantic drift detected; scale denied.

phases.name: EXACT_PROBLEM_ROLE_FIDELITY
phases.objective: Make all five current workers answer the exact same concrete problem from distinct roles with strict SPIRALIX and no drift.

phases.name: TRANSFER
phases.objective: Repeat quality gates on a different engineering/evidence problem.

phases.name: AUDIT_RESILIENCE
phases.objective: Run deterministic audit plus a separate counter-audit; reject rubber-stamping and preserve disagreements.

phases.name: MEMORY_RECALL_AND_CONTINUITY
phases.objective: Require agents to retrieve a verified prior capsule, cite its immutable pointer, and avoid treating memory as proof.

phases.name: SCALE_5_TO_10
phases.objective: Add only roles that provide new method/evidence diversity.

phases.name: SCALE_10_TO_20
phases.objective: Use up to 20 only when the hard problem justifies it.
